description: This is an HTML source file for a web frontend that visualizes Orleans activation load balancing metrics using D3.js. It includes embedded CSS styles, JavaScript code for dynamic chart rendering, data fetching, and user interactions.

methods.name: updateChart
methods.description: Updates the visualizations with new silo data, including updating bar charts and line charts based on activation counts.

methods.name: fetchData
methods.description: Fetches silo statistics data from the API endpoint and triggers chart updates.
